messages:
marina: FYI Verdant (acct verdant-7) just triggered a spend anomaly: embeddings token rate jumped ~5x in 48h. QBR is in 6 business days. Need a short triage + cost mitigation plan and a dollarized forecast for the deck.

leo: Can we get prod vs non-prod split + whether this is steady or a burst? Also want any notes on onboarding status (are they finishing a migration?)

jordan: Ran a quick rollup, query below: 

```sql
SELECT env, SUM(tokens) AS tokens_last_7d
FROM usage
WHERE account='verdant-7' AND ts > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY env;
```

jordan: Output: prod=46,200,000 tokens, dev=3,800,000 tokens last 7d. Baseline prod week was ~9M tokens. Looks like a backfill/process loop started Sun night.

clare: Flagging renewal health as "at risk" until we show runway. Suggest immediate mitigations: 1) cap non-prod to 1k reqs/day, 2) enable prefix KV caching for their embed pipeline (should cut repeated calls), 3) recommend moving heavy offline batches to our batch-optimized endpoint (lower cost per token).

marina: Good. Jordan, can you estimate 1- and 3-month spend given current rate? Use placeholder price $0.00055 per 1k tokens so AE/CS can see $ impact.

jordan: Quick calc: current prod 46.2M tokens/week => ~184.8M tokens/mo. + dev ~15.2M/mo => total ~200M tokens/mo. At $0.00055 per 1k => 200,000k * $0.00055 = $110k/mo. If this is sustained next 3 months without action, that's the projected spend.

leo: Oof. Add two scenarios in the QBR: (A) no action, (B) apply mitigations (prefix caching + 60% throttle on ad-hoc batch jobs + switch to quantized embed model). Estimate B.

jordan: For scenario B assumptions: prefix caching reduces repeat tokens by 30% on average, throttle reduces batch volume by 60% (batch is ~70% of prod tokens), quantized model saves ~15% per token. Applying those: effective tokens = 200M * (1 - 0.30*0.7) * (1 - 0.15) approx => I'll put exact math in deck, rough new spend ~ $34k2k/mo (ballpark).

clare: Ops ask: create budget alert at 70% of current monthly forecast and a daily anomaly detector that opens a triage thread if day-over-day tokens >2x. csm-bot, can you provision the alert and daily check?

csm-bot: [Alert Created] budget_alert:verdant-7:70pct notifications to @marina @leo @clare. Daily anomaly monitor enabled. Will post to #customer-success/triage if triggered.

marina: Action owners for QBR prep:
- jordan: add 1/3/6 month forecasts (dollarized) + exact math (due in 24h)
- clare: mitigation playbook (short steps for their ML team) + enablement script (due in 48h)
- leo: renewal talking points + risk level note (due in 48h)

leo: For enablement script include copyable commands to show top embedding jobs by token count and a sample curl to switch to the batch-optimized endpoint. Example commands: 

```
# top jobs by tokens
SELECT job_id, SUM(tokens) FROM job_runs WHERE account='verdant-7' GROUP BY job_id ORDER BY SUM(tokens) DESC LIMIT 10;

# switch to batch endpoint
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/model/batch-switch -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d '{"project":"verdant","endpoint":"batch-optimized"}'
```

clare: Also include a short FAQ for their ML lead: "Why did this backfill happen?" and "How to prevent runaway backfills". We'll ask them for the root cause during the enablement call.

marina: Let's default renewal risk to "high" until we show sustained mitigation or commit change to quota/policy. Ellie (AE) will need the $ numbers and slides to soften the conversation.

jordan: I'll prepare a small appendix with the exact SQLs and a reproducible notebook snippet to calculate token spend per job.

csm-bot: Will keep monitoring. If daily tokens for verdant-7 exceed 2.5x baseline for 3 consecutive days, I'll create an escalation and ping @leo.

marina: Thanks team. Please drop your deliverables in the #cs-qbr-prep folder and ping when ready. We'll rehearse the deck 24h before the QBR. :thumbsup:
